note: SMG hip candidate v2 skin regions (development trial, the SMG is a candidate, not adopted). Same areas and colour rules as the region proposal decided on 2026-10-22 (docs/review/player-parts/smg/region-proposal, README_design_review.md 5): weapon_body = housing (front block, receiver, rear end block incl. its dark lower face, round bolt at the stock base); fixed colour = muzzle / barrel nut, sights, magazine, grip and trigger, wire stock and hinge plate, tan slot frame, line black. Hands = glove, wrist band, sleeve base / camo. Base = the displayed derivative smg_hip_candidate_v2_opaque.png (the original is only read). Read by Tools/pixelart/make_image_regions.py.

steel.why: dark grey steel housing (lightness median 0.24); the tan slot frame and the gloves are more saturated

front_block.why: front block of the housing under the front sight (the sight posts and their base above y 446 stay fixed)

receiver.why: receiver with the side slots; the rear sight above (1250-1330, 465-545) stays fixed; the magazine below y 700 stays fixed

rear_block.why: rear end block of the housing, including its dark lower face down to the right glove; the stock hinge plate (x 1380-1452, y 650-745) and the wire stock right of it stay fixed

arms.why: both hands and sleeves (glove / sleeve colours do not occur on the gun)

stock_hinge_knob.why: round bolt at the stock base: recoloured with the housing (the hinge plate around it and the wire stay fixed)

pixelSeeds.why: front block side face: the cell runs into the barrel nut / sight base, so only its pixels inside the area are taken
